standing_gates.finding_clause: TryResolveMoralChoice had zero call sites across production runtime code.
standing_gates.enforcement_rule: Every public Core domain decision method must have a valid host caller or documented consumer.

standing_gates.finding_clause: Thirty routed consoles reported IsBound = true with no backing gameplay authority.
standing_gates.enforcement_rule: UI panels may only report IsBound = true when connected to a live domain system or host session.

standing_gates.finding_clause: 272 data catalogs were codex-only with EFFECT_PRODUCED = 4.
standing_gates.enforcement_rule: Data catalogs must declare behavioral consumers or be classified as passive codex records.

standing_gates.finding_clause: ZoneRadLevel was set by an ad-hoc survivor-id ternary instead of a single authority.
standing_gates.enforcement_rule: Environmental radiation levels must be set exclusively by the canonical WeatherSystem and RadiationLedger.

standing_gates.finding_clause: DegradeRate = 0f and degradation operated on a throwaway copy.
standing_gates.enforcement_rule: Item and structure degradation must mutate canonical state with non-zero rates and soak test verification.

standing_gates.finding_clause: Inventory.Consume was called with every callback argument null.
standing_gates.enforcement_rule: Inventory operations must provide valid callbacks or route through canonical mutation event sinks.

standing_gates.finding_clause: Duty roster assignment read no survivor health or needs anywhere.
standing_gates.enforcement_rule: Duty assignments must gate on survivor fitness, health status, and acute needs.

standing_gates.finding_clause: Three CI gates were red while AGENTS.md cited a class that did not exist.
standing_gates.enforcement_rule: Instruction rulebooks must remain synchronized and all referenced types must exist in codebase.

standing_gates.finding_clause: SimulateDailyFriction was never called in the daily lifecycle tick.
standing_gates.enforcement_rule: Daily simulation methods defined in Core must be invoked by the host daily lifecycle pump.

standing_gates.finding_clause: 20 of 27 emitted event kinds were dropped by a switch statement without a default branch.
standing_gates.enforcement_rule: Event kind handlers must handle all declared enum variants or provide an explicit exhaustive fallback.

standing_gates.finding_clause: A 6-node wasteland graph was described as 261 nodes in documentation.
standing_gates.enforcement_rule: Documentation and registry claims must accurately reflect verified graph node counts.

standing_gates.finding_clause: 74 of 147 Core integration seams lacked host callers.
standing_gates.enforcement_rule: Declared integration seams must have verified host callers or documented headless test consumers.

standing_gates.finding_clause: Zero of 16 navigation, focus, and controller affordances were wired in panels.
standing_gates.enforcement_rule: UI panels must support keyboard focus and controller navigation mappings.

standing_gates.finding_clause: InferBeliefProfile guessed data that 72 authored records already contained.
standing_gates.enforcement_rule: Survivor beliefs and traits must load from authored data catalogs rather than speculative synthesis.

standing_gates.finding_clause: Affinity was computed by three separate systems but read by zero consumers.
standing_gates.enforcement_rule: Relational affinity calculations must directly impact task outcomes, morale, or cooperation.

standing_gates.finding_clause: 27 balance CSVs existed in repository with no reproducible generator scripts.
standing_gates.enforcement_rule: Balance data files must be accompanied by reproducible simulation scripts or generators.
standing_gates.non_gate_rule: 2026-09-23 decision: not gated. No generator currently owns the balance CSV set, so a gate would fail on infrastructure that does not exist. Human instrument: the monthly balance review ritual (docs/balance/REVIEW_RITUAL.md) records which CSVs are reproducible. Owner: BalanceSpecialist. Gate lands with the reproducible-sweep generator.
